svg.title: VLP enrichment protocol with MagNA Pure extraction, seven steps
svg.desc: Horizontal strip of seven panels: chip and weigh frozen stool, homogenize in SM buffer, clarify by centrifugation, filter once through 0.45 micron, digest with lysozyme and two DNases, stop the reaction with EDTA, and extract on the MagNA Pure using magnetic beads.
svg.text: Two stop points at −80 °C: after filtering (one 800 µL working aliquot plus 100 µL spares) and again after EDTA.
